projects.name: Spin-diode · RF harvesting
projects.title: MTJ spin-diode rectification for RF energy harvesting
projects.summary: Rectified voltage of pMTJs from SPINTEC wafer VB01-23 (FeCoB free-layer and polarizer wedges). Device selection from whole-wafer Veeco R–H data, focusing on canted devices and high TMR.
facts: RF source changed in Nov 2026 from MiniCircuits SSG-6000RC to Agilent E8257D (20 GHz)
−6 dB attenuator between source and device: power at device = set power − 6 dB
Devices have a field line on top
Ursula is interested in broadband rectification
next: Spin-diode signal vs RF power: separate the resonant and the magnetic contributions
Quick R–H and H = 0 spectra on the priority devices of dies EN and DM
Consider re-injecting the STNO output into the device to raise V_rect

projects.name: EP encirclement
projects.title: Multi-turn EP encirclement in coupled STVOs (PRB)
projects.summary: Encircling exceptional points in a pair of coupled vortex STNOs: full range of gains, different encirclement loops, and amplitude death at high gain. Mostly experimental; extends Ho et al., Newton 2026 and Wittrock et al., Nat. Commun. 2024 with the same samples and theory.
facts: EP mapping vs gain recorded on the combined output of both STVOs
Encirclement loops recorded with STVO A and STVO B read out separately (STNO1 = STVO A output, STNO2 = STVO B output; one device pair)
STVO A is the fixed oscillator (biased in C-state)
Gain dependence: four gains in the C-state configuration plus one C-state loop at lower gain; field 435 mT
next: Measure the C-state EP loops (2CW and CW+CCW around one EP)
Replace mock figures with real data on Overleaf
Send the draft to Vincent and Romain

projects.name: Floquet
projects.title: Floquet drive on coupled STNOs
projects.summary: RF drive (SMB100B) on coupled STNOs, proposed by Romain. Goal: observe the same Floquet behaviour in both the crossing and the anticrossing regime.
facts: Related to the EP encirclement work
next: Compare crossing and anticrossing regimes under the same drive

projects.name: STVO array
projects.title: Dipolar-coupled STVO arrays (Tristan da Câmara, UCLouvain / INL)
projects.summary: Four array samples received 06/11/2026. Goals: prove genuine locking, measure RF emission, and measure the Py-capped samples.
facts: S1: no Py, common contact · S2, S3: 10 nm Py cap · S4: no Py, separate contacts
None of S1–S4 has been measured before; Tristan's INL results are on another die
Measurement workbook STVO_array_Tristan_die_map.xlsx is kept in the sDrive “Spin Diode” folder
next: Start with the close pairs on S1 (per Vincent)
First device: N5 on S1, wire-bonded 16/11/2026
Limit current and protect against ESD: many INL devices died during spin-diode measurements
